claims.text: The datasets used in the experiment are the LibriSpeech corpus and the GlobalPhone corpus.
The LibriSpeech corpus consists of 960 hours of English audio data, with 2.2 million segments for training.
The GlobalPhone corpus includes data in French, German, Czech, and Spanish, with 20 thousand segments sampled for each language.
